description: The pins of this baseline: Microsoft's official file, where to download it, its SHA-256, and which of its GPOs the kit applies, in order. Nothing of the file itself is in the repository: scripts/Get-Baselines.py downloads it into the work folder (<work>/baselines), checks the SHA-256 and imports it there (scripts/Import-Baseline.py), and the build stages that data into the image. 'page' is Microsoft's download page (Security Compliance Toolkit), for when the file at 'url' has been replaced.
name: Microsoft Windows 11 v26H2 Security Baseline v2
note: Microsoft replaced the first release of this baseline ('Windows 11 v26H2 Security Baseline.zip', SHA-256 bc4c35d8b19fa8863ee37cac24ad518c501913ae4a682aed08190487d5b2f4d2) in place by this v2; the first one can no longer be downloaded. v2 has the same eight GPOs under new GUIDs and one more setting: ConsentPromptBehaviorEnhancedAdmin=4,1 in the Computer GPO's security template (the credential prompt of Administrator protection, which the kit turns off).
localInstall: Scripts/Baseline-LocalInstall.ps1 -Win11DomainJoined: LGPO /g for each GPO below, sorted by name; no NonDomainJoined delta (it re-enables remote admin with local accounts).

extensions.description: Group Policy client-side extensions Microsoft's installer registers for local policy ('LGPO /e mitigation /e audit /e zone /e DGVBS', registered for Computer and User alike), on top of those the GPOs' Backup.xml files name. Apply-Policy.ps1 lists them in the local GPO's gpt.ini.
